Captured in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, deleted and deletion verified. The internal Lead sharing model was ReadWriteTransfer and its external sharing model was omitted. A custom profile used the Partner Community user license and API Enabled; the authenticated Partner user had an assigned permission set granting Lead Read. Two administrator-owned Leads existed. The same anonymous query ran at APIs 62.0 and 67.0 before and after a separate committed direct Manual Read share of the first Lead. The profile and permission setup used the Salesforce CLI; no IDs are included in the rows.
In a separate fresh 30-day scratch org with the same profile and license setup, a setup query recorded the user's UserType and the profile's license Name and LicenseDefinitionKey in profile.tsv. That org was also deleted and deletion verified.
